resources.string: Tint the app to match the icon
Buttons, switches, selections and the widgets take the icon\'s colour. Colours from album art stay as they are.
Rose is Riff\'s own pink, so there is nothing to tint. Choose another colour to use this.

Moves wide stretches for a fuller change
Drag left for a warmer sound and right for a brighter one; down scoops the middle, up brings it forward. Focused works on narrower stretches, so it changes less around what it moves.
Using both adds their effects together.
